court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Civil Judge, Senior Division, Kalyan, RCC No. 261 of 2015
case_name: Vijay Mohanlal Makhija And Anr vs The State Of Maharashtra And Anr

parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Maharashtra & Anr (wife's side, state)

facts_of_case: Matrimonial dispute settled between applicant No.1's son and respondent No.2; petition filed seeking divorce by mutual consent under Section 13(B) of the Hindu Marriage Act; trial court allowed the petition and dissolved the marriage.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the respondent to come forward and give her consent for quashing of the complaint.
legal_principles.held: Despite the same, the respondent No.2 is not coming forward for giving her consent for quashing of the said complaint.

legal_principles.principle: Parties have agreed to withdraw all the criminal and civil cases filed by them against each other and/or their family members.
legal_principles.held: He submits that parties have agreed to withdraw all the criminal and civil cases filed by them against each other and/or their family members.

outcome.final_order: Issue notice to respondents returnable on 20th December, 2022; proceedings before the trial Court stayed till next date.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for mutual consent divorce under Hindu Marriage Act
advising on alimony payments in family law cases
representing clients in Bombay High Court
